definition.dose: the same written state is stepped with fast x0 and fast x1000
definition.stages: h, z, logits and probabilities are captured with forward hooks
definition.relative: rel_x = ||delta_x||2 / ||x_ref||2, the same units inside each stage
definition.attenuation: rel_next / rel_prev for readout, generate and softmax
definition.output: KL(p0||pk), KL(pk||p0) and TV on the two distributions
definition.decision: a stage attenuation below 0.1 marks a damping site
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy readings on the main subject stay equal before and after

criteria.write: the written fast has abs sum > 0
criteria.ratios: all three attenuations and the four rel values are reported
criteria.decision: one site -> localised, several -> distributed, none -> absent (frozen 0.1 rule)
criteria.kl: KL(p0||pk), KL(pk||p0) and TV are reported
criteria.measurable: the measurable exit follows the frozen KL/TV floors
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal and the main parameter digest does not move
criteria.rerun: the R42 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256
